title: Developer Journey Instrumentation & Initiative Tracker
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, reusable initiative tracker and instrumentation surface for Developer Experience programs (SDKs, docs, quickstarts) to make OKR progress visible, automate cycle reporting, and surface regression signals that should drive prioritization. This ticket covers the product definition, metric contract, required telemetry events, dashboards, and a minimal set of integrations with Linear, Console analytics, and Confluence so PMs and Eng leads can run week-to-week cadence without manual spreadsheets.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumented events for onboarding funnel: signup -> SDK install -> first API call -> first successful embed or generation
Dashboard with per-cohort conversion, time-to-first-success, and regression alerts for each SDK/language
Weekly automated initiative report generated to Confluence and posted to #devx-team with top 3 risks and recommended actions
Integration test that validates event ingestion and schema stability for a sample quickstart
Runbook for triaging regression alerts with owners and SLAs documented
progress_updates: 2026-01-20: Kickoff with Eng leads and DX designers. Agreed core funnel and three priority SDKs (js, python, go). Drafted metric contracts.
2026-01-28: Data schema v1 posted to Confluence (see links). Decided to use event names prefixed devx_ and a common 'journey_stage' enum to keep queries predictable.
2026-02-11: PoC ingestion pipeline validated against Console analytics for js-sdk quickstart. Observed missing 'first_success' in 12% of flows; investigation opened with ENG-14220.
2026-02-22: Design review: added a compact weekly summary card and a deep-dive funnel page. UX asks for cohort breakdown by channel (self-serve vs sales-assisted).
2026-02-26: PM review: prioritized regression-alerting over cohort segmentation for initial rollout to reduce time-to-value.
2026-03-03: GitHub PR #1345 implements schema transform and e2e test for quickstart. Currently in review; linking PR and deployment runbook.
2026-03-05: Risk: instrumentation on embedded examples in docs requires change to docs pipeline. Scoped a minimal shim to capture events without full docs build rewrite.
review_feedback: Sofia Martinez (Eng Manager): prefer stable event names; recommended adding an 'sdk_version' tag to help triage client-side regressions.
Diego Ramirez (DX Designer): dashboard should prioritize hypotheses-driven metrics not raw counts; suggested 'time-to-success' and 'success rate per 1k users'.
Priya Nair (Security): tooling is ok but ensure no PII sent in events; add a privacy validation checklist to the delivery pipeline.
notes: Trade-offs: scoped down cohort segmentation to hit MVP in a single cycle; we can iterate after first two weeks of alerts.
Decision log: use Console analytics as the canonical source for reports; export CSV via nightly job for finance reconciliation.
Follow-ups: schedule 30-minute onboarding with Support to ensure they can interpret alerts and escalate appropriately.
QA plan: include synthetic user flows for js and python quickstarts that assert 'first_success' within 90s on CI runs.
